tools.name: list_prepport_services
tools.description: List public PrepPort sourcing, product inspection, FBA preparation, storage and fulfillment services with starting rates, exclusions and source pages.

tools.name: estimate_prepport_base_cost
tools.description: Calculate an illustrative USD base-service subtotal from public rates. Inspection needs sampleChecks; prep needs units; fulfillment needs orders; storage needs cubicMeters and months. Sourcing is quote-only. Excludes freight and other pass-through costs; does not submit or approve a quote.

tools.name: plan_prepport_first_job
tools.description: Return the requirements, approval steps and registration link for a first sourcing request, inspection, inbound shipment, FBA prep or fulfillment order.
